title: Early checkout for personal convenience
facts_text: I booked a four-night stay and have already checked in. After the first night, I decided to return home early for personal reasons. There is no problem with the room and no hotel-related issue. I want to leave three nights early.
request: Can you end my stay and refund the three unused nights?

strict.reason: The guest has already checked in and the strict policy does not allow a refund for unused nights after early checkout.
strict.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

exception.reason: There is no verified serious room defect, so the experimental early-checkout exception does not apply.
